linc-61

• Biological Process:  
  – Predicted to be involved in development; reproduction; metabolism; cellular localization and organization; immune response; rhythmic process; and response to stimuli.  
  – Involved in response to xenobiotic stimulus.  
  – Acts upstream of or within response to stress.

• Pathways:  
  – Predicted to be part of development; apoptosis; cell division; neuronal development and neurodegeneration; metabolism; and oxidative stress response.

• Expression:  
  – Is expressed in the intestine.

• Modifiers:  
  – linc-61 ameliorates the nanopolystyrene-induced toxicity phenotype.
